verdict.rationale: ClickHouse Cloud docs reference 'Migration guides from various platforms' and ClickPipes support ingestion from Postgres/MySQL/MongoDB/etc., suggesting a documented path to move data in from an existing production database. However, the evidence never details a minimal-downtime cutover strategy (e.g., CDC replication, dual-write, or sync-then-switch process) or downtime guarantees. Missing for 10: explicit minimal-downtime migration walkthrough, CDC/replication tooling details, hands-on validation of a production cutover with low downtime.
